introHtml: Tangle lanyards combine the durability of braided nylon with a unique, tangle-free design that stays comfortable against the neck all day. Unlike flat polyester straps, the round cord construction prevents twisting and curling, making them ideal for busy trade shows, schools, or corporate offices where IDs must be scanned quickly. Choose from multiple widths and attachment styles to match your badge needs.
